title: Framework zero-tolerance invariants
description: Invariants whose target is zero, with their OBSERVED history. The aggregate stability score may never override one of these: a scoreboard that can average away a violated invariant is not a control. Canonical serialization: UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted, separators (',',':').

observed.description: Recorded violations with their closure. A target of zero with no measurement is an aspiration, and resetting a closed violation to zero erases the only evidence the invariant was ever tested against reality.
